c1_ariete_proto_serie1.name: C1 Ariete Prototype (Serie 1)
c1_ariete_proto_serie1.authority: The owner, 2026-11-01: "now update the c2 protottype, c1 prototype s1, ariete preserie ...". Release 268 (item/italy-korea-bmp-267, profiles/italy.ts buildArieteMkSteps) refits the 1986-88 C1 prototype from photographs; no free photograph of the six prototypes exists, so the series C1 Ariete, the closest sibling (same hull, turret, gun and running gear), is the photographic reference. Its registered oracle ariete_c1_arrafi.glb shows the series C1, another variant, and is unregistered (Main's ruling 2026-10-28). It won its blind A/B against the previous build in two rounds, 2-0 each (arieter1 and arieter2). Stage A's photo route through this packet is proposed to Main in the 268 READY. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
c1_ariete_proto_serie1.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule), on the spec's owner gameplay enlargement of the C1 chassis (x1.10: the published C1's 7.59 m hull, 9.67 m overall and 3.61 m over the skirts). Width over the track guards; length from the stern to the 120 mm muzzle with the gun forward. Tallest is the tip of the whip antenna; the turret roof fittings stand 2.87 m.

c2_ariete_proto.name: C2 Ariete Prototype
c2_ariete_proto.authority: The owner, 2026-11-01: "now update the c2 protottype, c1 prototype s1, ariete preserie ...". Release 268 (item/italy-korea-bmp-267, profiles/italy.ts buildArieteMkSteps) rebuilds the C2 prototype from five Italian Army photographs of the real Ariete C2 (acceptance trials, the Cavalry School, the first serial vehicle): bolted cheek, shoulder and bustle plates, armour-block skirts over the front of the run, the panoramic commander's sight and the loader's shielded 12.7 mm. Its registered oracle ariete_c1_arrafi.glb shows the series C1, another variant, and is unregistered (Main's ruling 2026-10-28). It won its blind A/B against the previous build in two rounds, 2-0 each (arieter1 and arieter2). Stage A's photo route through this packet is proposed to Main in the 268 READY. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
c2_ariete_proto.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule), on the spec's owner gameplay enlargement of the C1 chassis (x1.10; the real C2 keeps the C1's 7.59 m hull). Width over the owner-ordered field net's garnish on the skirts (1.99 m a side over the hull armour). Length from the stern to the 120 mm muzzle with the gun forward. Tallest is the tip of the whip antenna; the turret roof stands 3.19 m.
